authoritative_state: exposed_frequency rebuilt from every non-target nonzero cached vector term

entry.committed: checked u32 frequency or u32::MAX new-row sentinel

buckets: frequency-indexed Vec<Vec<Mono>>; every committed bucket is strictly natural-Mono sorted
delta: one folded remove/add per touched row at commit; removal must be a subset and addition must not collide
rank_order: ascending numeric frequency, then natural Mono order
map_index_guard: every new nonzero term asserts index count equals exposed_frequency count; every commit asserts bucket/entry census and strict dirty buckets; full map-count/order equality is a mandatory external gate
restart: rebuild index from authoritative vector cache; never alter checkpoint or vector-cache schemas
